operations.name: crm.contacts.find
operations.subject: email
operations.summary: Every contact that carries the address email, oldest first: {email, contacts, count}, each contact {id, email, created_at, updated_at, lifecycle_stage} and nothing else of the person; two or more are duplicates. Scoped: a call that serves a case answers only the case's subject.

operations.name: crm.contacts.create
operations.subject: email
operations.summary: Create a contact with the address email, and nothing else of the person: answered as a found contact, with replayed. The product's tool recognises a repeated request_id itself. Scoped as the read is.

operations.name: crm.contacts.note
operations.subject: email
operations.summary: Write text as a note of a touchpoint on the oldest contact carrying email: answered {contact, note, replayed}. The product's tool recognises a repeated request_id itself. Scoped as the read is.
